lines.text: Many learners say: I will see you in next week.
Better: I will see you next week.
Do not use in before next.
The second! See you next year.

data.wrong: I will see you in next week.
data.right: I will see you next week.
data.why: Do not use in before next.

native.tip: نقول «في الأسبوع القادم»، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول next week دون in: “I will see you next week.” وليس “I will see you in next week.”

en.tip: In Arabic we say «في الأسبوع القادم», but in English we say next week with no in: “I will see you next week.” not “I will see you in next week.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “I will see you in next week.” 😅 In Arabic we say «في الأسبوع القادم», but in English we say next week with no in, so the right sentence is “I will see you next week.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
